warrant: This check grades the numerical quantities named in output-contract.json on the independently materialized official operands. skimage.segmentation.felzenszwalb (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/segmentation/_felzenszwalb.py:7): fixed image operands and segmentation parameters determine physical region membership; component labels are arbitrary names, while the region partition and background are the graded quantities; skimage.segmentation.slic (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/segmentation/slic_superpixels.py:105): fixed image operands and segmentation parameters determine physical region membership; component labels are arbitrary names, while the region partition and background are the graded quantities; skimage.segmentation.watershed (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/segmentation/_watershed.py:87): fixed image operands and segmentation parameters determine physical region membership; component labels are arbitrary names, while the region partition and background are the graded quantities. The named precision bounds retain exact discrete results and allow small floating rounding changes; a resolved one-percent gain error, a changed integer count or a changed physical region is not treated as numerical noise. The perturbation reaches only materialized call 3 (skimage.color.rgb2gray); its CLI-recorded spread is sensitivity evidence for that workload, not a floor for every other call. No alternative-build or accelerator floor is claimed. The source-linked bounds remain proposals until the human reviews the measured calibration and accepts their scientific scope.
